name: Microsoft Entra Agent ID
description: Agent identity objects inside the Microsoft Entra suite, tied to Agent 365.
descriptionZh: Microsoft Entra 套件内的 Agent 身份对象，与 Agent 365 绑定。
keyFact: Microsoft Entra Agent ID introduces four object types — agent identity blueprint, blueprint principal, agent identity and agent user — into Microsoft Entra, and ties into Conditional Access, ID Protection and lifecycle governance; licensing requires Microsoft 365 E7 or Microsoft Agent 365.
keyFactZh: Microsoft Entra Agent ID 在 Microsoft Entra 中引入四类对象——代理标识蓝图、蓝图主体、代理标识与代理用户，并接入条件访问、ID Protection 与生命周期治理；其许可需 Microsoft 365 E7 或 Microsoft Agent 365。
